title: werf-includes.yaml
description:
werf includes configuration: remote git repositories whose files are imported into the project configuration. Resolved commits are pinned in werf-includes.lock.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/reference/werf_includes_yaml.html

includes.description: Configuration of remote git repositories for import.

include.description: A remote repository to import files from. Exactly one of `branch`, `tag` or `commit` must be set.

git.description:
The address of the remote repository.
https://werf.io/docs/latest/usage/build/stapel/git.html#working-with-remote-repositories

basicAuth.description: Basic authentication for the remote repository.

password.description: Password source. Exactly one of `env`, `src` or `value` must be set.

branch.description: The name of the branch to import files from. Incompatible with `tag` and `commit`.

tag.description: The name of the tag to import files from. Incompatible with `branch` and `commit`.

commit.description: The commit hash to import files from. Incompatible with `branch` and `tag`.

add.description: The directory in the remote repository to import files from. An absolute path relative to the repository root.

to.description: The directory in the local repository to import files to. An absolute path relative to the repository root.

includePaths.description: Globs of files in the remote repository to import, relative to `add`. All files are imported when omitted.

excludePaths.description: Globs of files in the remote repository to exclude from import, relative to `add`.
